'''D-04-05''' was a damage report detailing the financial costs following the malfunction of twenty [[Q-4 Borer Droid]]s which triggered a tunnel collapse. Over 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] worth of damage was caused in the incident.
